paper.title_en: Quasinormal Modes of a Black Hole in a Dehnen-Type Dark Matter Halo with Radial Pressure
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of scalar and (axial) gravitational perturbations of a black hole spacetime surrounded by a Dehnen-type dark matter (DM) halo with nonvanishing radial pressure. Our results reveal that the real and imaginary parts of the QNMs exhibit distinct redshift coefficients with respect to the DM halo compactness $M/a_0$, in contrast to the vanishing radial pressure case. The magnitude of this effect is dominated by the profile parameter $γ$, and the damping rate is more sensitive to the DM halo compactness than the oscillation frequency. In the eikonal limit, the redshift deviations are well captured by the light ring angular velocity $Ω_c$ and the Lyapunov exponent $λ$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究带有径向压力的Dehnen型暗物质晕中黑洞的标量与轴引力扰动准正规模，属于黑洞扰动与强引力场基础理论范畴，理论层次较深，并给出eikonal极限下与光子环角速度及Lyapunov指数的对应关系，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 带径向压力的Dehnen型暗物质晕中黑洞的准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了被具有非零径向压力的Dehnen型暗物质（DM）晕所包围的黑洞时空中，标量扰动与（轴）引力扰动的准正规模（QNMs）。我们的结果表明，与径向压力为零的情形不同，QNMs的实部和虚部相对于暗物质晕致密度$M/a_0$表现出不同的红移系数。该效应的幅度由轮廓参数$γ$主导，且阻尼率对暗物质晕致密度比振荡频率更为敏感。在eikonal极限下，红移偏差可由光子环角速度$Ω_c$和Lyapunov指数$λ$很好地刻画。
